# TradingView

> Advanced charting platform and social network for traders offering real-time market data, technical analysis tools, broker integrations, and community-driven trading ideas across stocks, forex, crypto, and futures.

TradingView provides professional-grade financial visualization tools, broker comparisons, and embeddable widgets for traders and investors. The platform integrates with major brokers including Interactive Brokers, Webull, tastytrade, and cryptocurrency exchanges, while maintaining compliance with regulatory bodies like FINRA, SEC, CFTC, and NFA.

## Key Topics

- Broker comparisons and integrations
- Trading fees and commission structures
- Regulatory compliance (FINRA, SEC, CFTC, NFA, SIPC)
- Futures trading platforms
- Stock trading and order types
- Forex broker features
- Cryptocurrency trading and exchanges
- Embeddable chart widgets
- Technical analysis tools
- Market data visualization
- Multi-asset trading platforms
- Broker regulatory oversight
- Trading platform features
